settings.title: Settings
settings.marketHint: Changing the market sets the units, sheet size and carcass thickness.
settings.grainCarcass: Carcass has grain (parts are not rotated)
settings.grainFront: Front has grain (parts are not rotated)
settings.subtractEdge: Subtract edge banding thickness from the cut size
settings.wallLengthHint: Optional. Used to check the length of the lower row.
settings.lede: These apply to the whole project. You can change them later.
settings.handleHint: Add the handles you use. In a cabinet's card you pick which goes where. The default applies to cabinets that do not pick their own.

builder.title: Builder
builder.empty: Add the first cabinet with the buttons above.
builder.noSelection: Select a cabinet in the drawing or the list to edit it.
builder.rowShort: {{diff}} short of the wall length (a filler is needed)
builder.doorSplitHint: Empty = one door over the full height.
builder.lede: Add cabinets, set their sizes and follow the drawing. The check on the side flags problems right away.
builder.boardHint: Type the type and color of the board. The same name in several cabinets is the same board, so they are counted together. Change thickness and sheet size in “Materials and worktop”.

validation.width: {{module}}: width {{W}} is out of the allowed range.
validation.doorTooWide: {{module}}: a single door is {{width}} wide. Consider two doors.
validation.partTooLarge: {{module}}: part “{{part}}” ({{L}} × {{Wd}}) does not fit the sheet.
validation.rowTooLong: The lower row ({{row}}) is longer than the wall ({{wallLength}}).
validation.rowShort: The lower row ({{row}}) is shorter than the wall ({{wallLength}}): a filler is needed.
validation.drawerHeights: {{module}}: drawer fronts plus gaps total {{total}}, but the cabinet height is {{H}}.
validation.wallDeeper: {{module}}: the wall cabinet ({{D}}) is deeper than the base cabinets ({{baseD}}).
validation.drawerBoxTooLow: {{module}}: the box of drawer {{drawer}} is too low ({{boxHeight}}).
validation.drawerTooShallow: {{module}}: depth {{D}} is too small for drawer slides.
validation.doorSplit: {{module}}: the door split ({{doorSplitH}}) must be between 0 and the cabinet height ({{H}}).

landing.title: Design your kitchen. Get the exact shopping and cutting list.
landing.subtitle: Kerfly turns your kitchen modules into a sheet count, edge banding meters, hardware and a cutting list with a layout for every sheet, so you never buy a sheet too many or too few.

one.title: Set up the sheets
one.text: Pick the market, sheet size, thickness, decors, grain and front gap. Show sizes in millimeters or inches.

two.title: Build the kitchen
two.text: Add base, wall and tall cabinets, drawer units and the sink. Edit sizes and follow the drawing with dimensions. The check flags errors right away.

three.title: Get the report
three.text: A shopping list, a cutting list per material (CSV) and a layout of the parts on every sheet, ready to print.

sheets.title: Sheets per decor
sheets.text: How many carcass and front sheets and how much HDF, with the utilization of every sheet.

edging.title: Edge banding in meters
edging.text: Thin and thick banding separately, with an allowance for cutting.

hardware.title: Worktop and hardware
hardware.text: Hinges, slides, legs, handles, shelf pins, wall hangers and confirmat screws.

cutting.title: Cutting list
cutting.text: A table per material with sizes, edges and grain. Export to CSV.

layouts.title: Sheet layouts
layouts.text: Every part is labeled with its name and size. Layouts are made for a saw that cuts edge to edge, with the kerf included.

check.title: Checks as you go
check.text: A part that does not fit the sheet, a row longer than the wall or drawers that do not fill the height: you see it before you calculate.

landing.privacyText: Your project stays in your browser. Export it to a JSON file and import it when you need it, on any device.
landing.ctaText: Start with the first cabinet. Everything else is calculated for you.
landing.kerfNote: Kerf is the width of the saw cut. It is included in every layout.

materials.title: Materials and worktop
materials.hint: The default boards (carcass, front, HDF) and decors are set in Settings. Here you add more boards and set up the worktop. You assign a board to a cabinet in its card.
